newsitem.title: JAPAN: Rover sees higher 1997 Japan sales.
newsitem.headline: Rover sees higher 1997 Japan sales.

text.p: Rover Japan Ltd, the Japanese unit of Rover Group Ltd, said on Friday it aims to sell 30,000 cars in Japan in calendar 1997, up from last year's record sales of 27,254 cars.
Rover Japan set a target of gaining a one percent share of Japan's passenger car market by 1998 and a 2.5 percent share by 2005.

The company also plans to add another 20 to 30 sales outlets in Japan in 1997, compared with 117 at present. Additional targets were set at 160 outlets by 1998, 200 outlets by 1999, and 300 outlets by 2005.
The company also plans to set up 25 to 30 sales outlets for used Rovers this year.
Rover Group is the British automobile unit of Germany's Bayerische Motoren-Werke AG (BMW).
